stepNotes.1: Barrel index.ts:1-9 re-exports 8 siblings; reducer (projection.ts) is isolated from I/O (event-sink-node.ts, runtime.ts) and side effects (effects.ts).
stepNotes.2: command union (command.ts:58-88) + event union (event.ts:84-101) versioned via HEADLESS_RUNTIME_SCHEMA_VERSION=1; HEADLESS_RUNTIME_EVENT_TYPES set (event.ts:107-165) is a manual second source of truth vs the union.
stepNotes.3: applyHeadlessProjectionEvent switch is exhaustive with a never guard at projection.ts:260; autonomous perm guard at projection.ts:114 uses Permission.isInteractiveOnly (permission/index.ts:208) to keep destructive ops human-gated.
stepNotes.4: Effects are fire-and-forget (effects.ts:61-66, runner.ts:104-107); runner.ts:106 defaults onWarn to no-op, so autonomous failures silently vanish when caller omits onWarn.
stepNotes.5: postJson (runtime.ts:103-127) throws with status+body on !ok and parses 200 via parseHeadlessRuntimeJsonBody; two `as any` casts at runtime.ts:85,88 leak past SDK types on permission/question reply.
stepNotes.6: event-log.ts:10-27 circular-guarded serializer falls back to a serialization_error record; event-sink-node.ts:20-39 handles backpressure and endStream does ordered finish/error cleanup; file sink opens flags:"w" (per-run truncate).
stepNotes.7: replay.ts structuredClone (lines 39,74,90) prevents source mutation; replayHeadlessEvents and replayHeadlessEventLogLines share near-duplicate loop bodies differing only in decoder.
stepNotes.8: Probe-key mapping duplicated inline in applyHeadlessProjectionEvent (projection.ts:213-257) and standalone in runtimeProbeKeysForEvent (264-302) which is a real public API consumed by tests + SDK mirror.
stepNotes.9: projection.test.ts (433 lines) covers reducer + probe keys; gap: no test for onWarn-omitted-under-autonomous behavior tied to the Step 4 finding; no Critical findings so no reverify pass required.
